description: Angular component and directive for an image card selection widget with responsive columns and options.

classes.name: ImageCardsSelectOptionDirective
classes.description: Directive representing an option in the image cards select component.

classes.name: ImageCardsSelectComponent
classes.description: Main component for selecting images with configurable columns, responsive behavior, and form control integration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes column layout based on breakpoints.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, especially 'cols'.

methods.name: ngAfterContentInit
methods.description: Sets up subscription to update options when content children change.

methods.name: _initCols
methods.description: Determines the number of columns based on configuration and breakpoints.

methods.name: _detectColumns
methods.description: Detects current number of columns considering breakpoints.

methods.name: syncImageCardsSelectOptions
methods.description: Synchronizes directive options with internal options array.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers callback for touch event (not used).

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the model value and propagates change.

methods.name: toggleSelectPanel
methods.description: Toggles the expanded state of the selection panel.

methods.name: updateDisplayValue
methods.description: Updates the display value based on current model.
